_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Saying th like s or d, and w like v

items.native: Dilin ucu dişlerin arasında, s değil
items.gloss_en: Put the tip of your tongue between your teeth, not s.

items.native: th için dili dişlerin arasına koy
items.gloss_en: Put your tongue between your teeth for the middle th.

items.native: w için dudaklar yuvarlak, v değil
items.gloss_en: Round your lips for w, not v.

items.native: v için üst dişler alt dudağa değer
items.gloss_en: Your top teeth touch your lower lip for v.

segments.text: Four words many learners say wrong. Listen, then repeat after me.

native.caption: “think” ve “mother” kelimelerindeki th sesini s ya da d gibi mi söylüyorsun? “water” kelimesinde w, “very” kelimesinde v sesine dikkat et. Ama öğretmeni dinle, sessizlikte tekrar et. Telaffuzu Lexkite uygulamasında çalış.

en.hook: 4 words Turkish learners often say wrong
en.caption: Do you say the th in “think” and “mother” like s or d? Be careful with w in “water” and v in “very”. Listen to teacher Ama, then repeat in the pause. Practice pronunciation in the Lexkite app.
